name: business
title: Business
description: The everyday tools of a small business: notes and a task board, two open-source apps with their history, and a crew that plans, builds and reviews changes you ask for.

apps.name: memos
apps.description: Quick notes and a shared journal for a team.

apps.name: kanboard
apps.description: A simple board for tasks and projects.

crew.brief: You turn what the business asks for into small, clear steps. Prefer the change that saves someone time this week.
You make the changes the planner lays out, in small steps, with tests where the app has them.
You review changes for a business that keeps customer information. Refuse anything that touches secrets or leaks data.
